description: This file contains unit tests for the BaseUnretireHandler class within the org.openmrs.api.handler package. It verifies the behavior of the handle method when unretiring Retireable objects such as Location, checking that retired status, retiredBy, dateRetired, and retireReason are correctly unset.

classes.name: BaseUnretireHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests to verify the behavior of the BaseUnretireHandler class when unretiring objects.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheRetiredBit
methods.description: Verifies that the handle method unsets the retired status of a Retireable object.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheRetirer
methods.description: Checks that the handle method clears the retiredBy field.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheDateRetired
methods.description: Ensures the dateRetired is nullified after handling.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetTheRetireReason
methods.description: Verifies that the retireReason is cleared.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotActOnAlreadyUnretiredObjects
methods.description: Confirms that if an object is already unretired, the handle method does not modify it.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotActOnRetiredObjectsWithADifferentDateRetired
methods.description: Ensures that handle does not re-unretire an object if the dateRetired does not match the current date.
